setlist.title: It Must Have Been the Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Attics of My Life** (2 reviews): The crowd was so quiet during Attics that you could hear a pin drop; Reviewer finds Attics overpowering [15][17]
- **Baba O'Riley** (2 reviews): Garcia did a mock Pete Townshend windmill gesture during Baba O'Riley; Welnick contributed to the encore pairing Baba O'Riley with Tomorrow Never Knows [20][22]
- **It Must Have Been the Roses** (1 review): Reviewer considers this one of the best versions of Roses ever [17]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the best So Many Roads of its era [21]
- **Spoonful** (1 review): Steve Miller, who opened the show, sat in from Spoonful through Morning Dew [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Attics, Spoonful and The Other One are described as pure Dead [21]

## The recordings

- **gd92-05-31.sbd.paino.544.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 170 min; rated 4.21/5 by 38 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes Garcia's guitar is missing from Slipknot until about three minutes in on the soundboard; Reports popping in the left channel, noticeable when the kick drum plays during Attics; Recording quality is great, but Garcia is very low in the mix and mostly inaudible [1][16][18]
- **gd1992-05-31.150298.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1992-05-31.sbd.miller.92388.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 3.5/5 by 6 [5]
- **gd1992-05-31.116420.josephsonc-640.chuckm.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [9]

## Around the show

- Desert wind cleared the clouds, revealing the night sky as Garcia began Attics of My Life [11]
- Recalls an early 5pm start, hours of intense heat with firehoses cooling the crowd, then a vivid sunset over the mountains [14]
- Steve Miller joined as a surprise guest near the end of the second set [20]
- Reviewer says the band lifted its playing once night fell during the second set [22]
- Steve Miller played guitar from Spoonful through Morning Dew [3]
- Steve Miller played guitar from Spoonful through Morning Dew [5]
- Venue is the Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, listed as in Whitney, NV [28]
- Having both Help>Slip>Frank and Scarlet>Fire in one show is called remarkable [15]
- Reviewer says it tops the Saturday show, which they also considered great [20]
- Reviewer says it followed the Saturday show impressively and was the best they'd seen [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd92-05-31.sbd.paino.544.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > SONY D8 (S/PDIF) > HD > SHN [1]. Also: Soundboard to DAT to Sony D8 via S/PDIF, then hard drive and SHN, via Mike Lai [1]
- **gd1992-05-31.150298.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 4, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [3]
- **gd1992-05-31.sbd.miller.92388.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Tape flips overlapped, so no patch was needed [5]
- **gd1992-05-31.116420.josephsonc-640.chuckm.flac16**: taped by Chuck Miller; transferred by Chuck Miller; source: Source: Josephson C-640 w/ KA-20 (cardioid) capsules > 5532 differential pre-amp (+21db) > Sony WMD-6C (Dolby C encoded); [9]. Also: Uploader says this source is being released digitally for the first time [9]
- Source chain: soundboard, possibly cassette, DAT, Sony D8 via S/PDIF, hard drive, SHN, WAV, FLAC [25]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-05-31 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-05-31-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [26]
